name: prose-lint
description: Lints the wording of a Japanese or English document and rules on every finding as fixed or kept with a reason. Japanese: textlint presets with the kana rules of 内閣訓令, your own register of rejected wordings, a sudachipy morphology lint, natural-japanese, a flow check on how sentences end and join, a norm check that lays the rates of ordinary forms beside a baseline of news text, a reader in a fresh context for translationese, an academic mode, and stop-ai-slop-jp for blog posts and slide decks. English: a reader, textlint, and vale with proselint and ai-tells. A translation is compared with its source. Hooks run the checks on what Claude writes. prose-lint is an independent project; proselint is a separate linter by other authors.

lint_hooks.title: Wording-check hooks
lint_hooks.description: Lint each document Claude writes, the Japanese in source files and each Japanese reply with textlint and your register, check each plan and question before it reaches you, and hand the findings to Claude. Change it later with /plugin configure prose-lint@prose-lint.
